episodes.name: A Deadly Discovery
episodes.overviewEn: Wolverine is drawn into a new investigation when a series of mysterious events points to a dangerous international conspiracy.

episodes.name: The Hunt Begins
episodes.overviewEn: Following a trail of clues across the globe, Wolverine searches for the people responsible before more lives are put at risk.

episodes.name: Tomorrow's Weapon
episodes.overviewEn: Evidence reveals the existence of a powerful new technology with the potential to change the balance of power forever.

episodes.name: Enemy Within
episodes.overviewEn: As allies and enemies become increasingly difficult to distinguish, Wolverine uncovers betrayals lurking beneath the surface.

episodes.name: Race Against Time
episodes.overviewEn: With a catastrophic threat growing closer to reality, Wolverine launches a desperate effort to stop the conspiracy before it is too late.

episodes.name: Tomorrow Dies Today
episodes.overviewEn: The truth is revealed as Wolverine confronts the masterminds behind the plot in a final battle to prevent global disaster.
